ghent-render.note: Full page rasterization (interpret + paint + toImage) via benchmark_render_test on the headless Flutter engine; captures paint + image-decode gains the NullDevice vm-sweep can't. Driven by env vars, not perf_sweep.

image-heavy.note: Heavy per-page RGB images (~8 MB decoded RGBA each, ~196 MB total) - the #283 scanned/photo memory shape. Exercises image decode + peak RSS / the decoded-image-cache budget work (#307/#314). Generated once + pre-seeded into tool/perf/cache/image-heavy so every version measures identical input.

image-render.note: Rasterizes the image-heavy doc (image decode + paint). Same generated corpus as image-heavy.

devicen-render.note: Rasterizes a DeviceN-image doc (3-colorant /DeviceN + type-4 tint -> CMYK, banded samples). The tint transform runs at decode, so this isolates the #282 memoisation: renderMs collapses ~2530 ms/page (1.4.6) -> ~98 ms/page (1.4.7). Generated + pre-seeded.

cad-wide-1p-sweep.note: the pathological single-sheet strip drawing behind the iPad-jank report: one ~8504x842pt page, ~850k paint commands in 8 /Contents streams. Exercises interpret + peak RSS + text-extract on a transcript that overflows the region-replay linear ceiling. HEAD-only (new generator), never backfilled.

cad-133p-scroll.note: app/tool/perf loop against the real local CAD PDF ($PERF_PDF); manual/local only

cad-synthetic-scroll.note: app/tool/perf loop against the generated cad-138p corpus; used by perf-web.yml
